question: Do I need to be a runner already?
answer: No. I coach runners and lifters of every level, and Run Club welcomes all paces. Every plan starts with a free 15-minute chat about where you are now and where you want to get to.

question: Can I do online coaching if I'm not in Edinburgh?
answer: Yes. Online coaching works wherever you live and train. You get a run and strength programme written for you, weekly check-ins and plan adjustments, and message support whenever you need it.

question: What happens in the first chat?
answer: It's a free 15-minute chat about where you are and where you want to get to, so we can work out which plan suits you. <mark>[Peter to confirm: is the chat by phone, video call or in person?]</mark> Before we start training, I'll ask you to fill in a short health questionnaire (PAR-Q).

question: What do I need for Run Club?
answer: Run Club is a weekly group speed session in 8-week blocks, outdoors and in most weather. Bring water and clothing suitable for the conditions, and wear something visible in the dark.

question: Can I pause my plan?
answer: You can end a monthly plan at any time by telling me before your next payment date, and you won't be charged again. <mark>[Peter to confirm: can clients pause a plan, for example for an injury or a holiday?]</mark> Missed Run Club sessions can't be refunded or carried over.

question: How do I pay?
answer: Monthly plans are paid <mark>[Peter to confirm: in advance on the same date each month, by bank transfer]</mark>. Run Club is paid in full before the first session of the block. See the [Terms & Conditions](/terms/) for the details.
